title: Chapter 485
paragraphs: Chapter 485
135. Brotherhood United (2)
February 27, 1800, a sandstorm raged outside the field barracks, making it impossible to see even an inch ahead.

The sandstorm, which blew all day with the force to cover everything, was annoying enough to make one feel nauseous just by watching it. However, it was undeniable that this very sandstorm had served as a curtain to hide the members of Runcandel for the past few weeks.
It had also been a curtain that concealed the existence of a massive airship construction site here until Zephyr intentionally leaked the information.
"Ugh…"
Diphus let out a low groan, rubbing his forehead.
Reading the news brought by the knights who had gone to the nearby village in the morning gave him a throbbing headache.
A fierce battle between the windstorm and the Black Emperor on the high seas in front of Tikan… As the two knights of the swordsmen swung their swords, the sea split and the sky opened.
The hierarchy war that began unexpectedly due to Mary Runcandel's provocation! The winner is said to be the 12th flagbearer…

Pirate Kommo, a confidant of the 7th generation Mary Runcandel, revealed that 'the Grand Captain wanted to keep fighting as soon as he heard the news of the 12th generation alone subduing the Black King', was the rumor of the Black King's situation true?
Rumors circulate that the 12th flagbearer was involved in a recent unidentified battle near the Gaipa military road… Was it Jin Runcandel who killed (or made missing) Amella?
Jemo, a confidant of the 12th flagbearer, confirmed, "It's true that Amella was also sent off with one stroke by our Nari."
Jin Runcandel, who became a generation and barely one year. He quickly climbed to the 5th place in the hierarchy. Will the Runcandel succession structure really change?
Overwhelming victory against the 7th generation! The 12th generation continues to soar; when will their legend continue?
"I expected Mary to cause some big trouble… I didn't know that she would have a public duel with the youngest."
It had already been more than a week since the news.
While the infiltration group was hiding in the Sota Desert, the world was in turmoil over Jin and Mary's fight.
"Do whatever you want for the time being. Cause accidents and train as you wish. I'll take responsibility for the aftermath."
He recalled the words he had spoken to Mary not long ago. Diphus had really planned to help Mary spread her wings.
However, the situation became urgent when Zephyr suddenly leaked information about the airship construction fleet.
Luna and Luntia were absent due to other missions, and the likelihood of lower-ranking knights becoming a burden was high.
So, in the dimension of helping one last time and leaving, he hurriedly sent a letter marked with an infiltration route.
He never expected the news of the youngest fighting would reach him first.
"Did they not receive the letter? No, that's impossible. If it's Mary's style… She must have told the youngest to fight, and the winner would come here to support."
Diphus sighed.
He hadn't completely ruled out the possibility of asking Jin for support.
Although he had just become the official 5th in the hierarchy, Jin's strength and ability had already been proven to be on par with the top knights during the declaration of the family head.
However, the reason why Diphus wanted Mary to come instead of Jin was none other than their synergy and teamwork.
Without a doubt, the brother Diphus trusted the most was Mary. If he had to entrust his back to someone in such a dangerous mission, it had to be Mary.
Moreover, in terms of teamwork, it was much better for Mary to join than Jin. Considering the relationship between Joshua and Jin, anyone would think so.
"Of course, Jin and Joshua would be clear about their respective roles, but... I don't feel very good about it."
Crack!
At that moment, both the front and back doors of the barracks opened simultaneously.
Joshua and the Black Knight, who had gone out for reconnaissance, entered through the front door, while Jin, who had just arrived, entered through the back door.
"...Youngest? Why you?"
Diphus shrugged his shoulders when Joshua signaled with his eyes, and Jin asked right away.
"There were quite a few strange passages in the infiltration route. Were they made by the 2nd flagbearer?"
Strange passages.
That was a question Diphus was curious about as well.
The infiltration route leading to Sota Desert was entirely created by Joshua. Diphus had also tried to form an infiltration route from another direction but failed and joined Joshua's path.
In the process, Diphus confirmed that Joshua's infiltration route was something that could not be created by ordinary magic or the power of a human.
Joshua's infiltration route had undoubtedly dug deep into the ground, but for some reason, it did not collapse and maintained its shape.
"Yes, I made them."
"It seemed like an infiltration route that couldn't be made by humans."
"Do you think that the same limitations apply to everyone? Then I must have seen you as too intelligent."
"Now you don't even hide the fact that you have a prophet or something as a helper?"
From the moment he met Joshua in Yeommyo after the declaration of the family head, Jin had been thinking that Joshua would soon reveal the existence of the prophet.
At that time, Jin openly talked about the prophet in front of other generations and elders, but Joshua didn't seem to be greatly disturbed.
"It seems like you're misunderstanding something."
Joshua shook his head and continued.
"I never hid the existence of the prophet. The reason you and other generations didn't know about their existence was because you didn't have enough access to information."
Jin chuckled, amused.
"Well, it's not a story I brought up to see such a sensitive reaction. Rather, it's reassuring to think that a long-held secret existence is helping us. We even have two Black Knights."
The Black Knights did not react to Jin's provocative remarks.
Joshua's gaze fell on Jin's shoulder. Murakan, transformed into a cat, was snoring on top of it.
"I also feel relieved, thinking that the guardian deity of our family is watching over this mission. Infiltration, penetration, and assassination are the goals, so you are more suitable than Mary."
While the two were conversing, Diphus was constantly aware of the word 'prophet.'
'How much does the youngest know about Joshua?'
And by what means did he find out?
Curiosity, confusion, and a heavy heart filled him.
Diphus had long suspected that Joshua had some special power or helper, but that was all he knew.

He had been tracking Joshua for a long time, but he could not find even the smallest clue as to what Joshua possessed. He had thought it was impossible to find out since Rosa was hiding Joshua's information personally.
On the other hand, Jin had been talking as if he knew about the prophet since the declaration of the family head, so Diphus couldn't help but feel somewhat frustrated.
'I need to think of a way to share information with the youngest. I have to act as quickly as possible, even if it's later than the youngest, but faster than Joshua.'
Diphus came to that conclusion, while Jin and Joshua continued to look at each other.
'I mentioned the Black Knight on purpose, but there's no reaction. Has Dox not gone to see Ricalton yet?'
Jin thought.
Jin hadn't received any contact from Dox yet, so he didn't know how his orders were being carried out.
Moreover, it wouldn't be difficult for someone like Joshua to hide his true intentions, whether Dox went to Ricalton or not.
Joshua smiled and pulled out a bundle of documents from his pocket.
"These are the details about the secret construction base we've gathered before your arrival and the strategy."
The documents contained detailed information on the internal structure of the secret construction base, the number of guards, dangers, and special notes.
'Is the facility of this scale built entirely underground?'
Jin felt a bit shocked looking at the internal structure. The size of the secret construction base was much larger than he had expected.
Joshua smiled, as if he knew Jin would react that way.

"There are a total of 24 areas, each the size of a decent castle. More than half of the underground desert is a secret construction base. It's puzzling how they managed to build such a large facility and keep it a secret all this time."
Several parts marked in red caught his eye.

"The marked areas are where the blueprints for the ships or the most important elements for ship construction are distributed. Areas 4, 11, 17, and 19. These four places have particularly tight security, and we haven't been able to access them yet."

Up until now, the infiltration team had been conducting internal reconnaissance using the power of the prophet. The fact that they couldn't infiltrate with that special power, two top-ranking knights, and two Black Knights meant that the only way in was by force.
And the moment they entered the four areas by force, the real time limit for this mission would begin.
"We'll have to choose carefully where to strike first. We probably only have one chance."

"That's right. The infiltration operation will start at 2 a.m. tomorrow. From then on, we'll gather information directly from inside and choose one of the four areas to begin the destruction and confiscation mission. The top priority is securing the ship blueprints and destroying the most critical resources. Is that enough explanation?"
Jin nodded.
"Alright, I'll take a short break then."
Joshua turned around, gathering the newsletters on the table.
"Also, congratulations on reaching the fifth rank. When you return, I'll give you a bottle of good wine as a gift."
"I'll gratefully accept it. Oh, and I'm grateful for your help with the Pen incident during the Black King Group situation."
It was another story about Dox.

At the time of the Black King Group situation, Joshua had ordered his newsletters to write favorable articles for Jin and Murakan, seeing that Dox had not returned, which ultimately raised the prestige of the family.
"Looking at those articles, I felt that the second flagbearer and I could work well together."
"I hope this mission goes the same way, Heufester's Black Prince. Hahaha..."
Hearing the nickname 'Black Prince,' Jin suddenly wanted to kill Cosmos.
As Joshua and the Black Knights left the barracks, Jin and Diphus naturally met each other's gaze.
"Second brother."
"Yeah."
Jin hesitated for a moment before speaking.
"....Let's kill that man in this mission."
At the sudden remark, Diphus could only widen his eyes in surprise.
